title: Juggling too many apps? How ProjectSight 360 Capture connects design and reality.
summary: Unlike other project management solutions, ProjectSight 360 Capture is fully embedded into your project controls. By connecting visual evidence with a single hub, teams can virtually walk the jobsite, rewind time to solve disputes and see the full story behind every project.
